items.headline: Jaylin Lucas runs for 214 yards, Tulane scores late in fourth quarter to top South Alabama 28-24
items.description: — Jaylin Lucas ran for a career-high 214 yards, Kadin Semonza connected with Destyn Hill on a 14-yard touchdown pass with 1:17 remaining in the fourth quarter, and Tulane defeated South Alabama 28-24 on Saturday night in a game where the lead changed...
